description: Gauge-invariant ground-space stabilizer 2-Renyi entropy M_2 of the doubled-Fibonacci Levin-Wen ground state on the edge-qubit honeycomb torus, minimized/scanned over the full four-dimensional ground space (Sec. 'Three certificates', item 2). Reproduces the certificate range M_2 in [6.5, 8.9] reported in the text (min 6.521069, max 8.936406 over the runs below), i.e. >> 0 under every representative, against the exact-zero Z_2 toric-code control on the same geometry.

provenance.quantity: Stabilizer 2-Renyi entropy M_2 = -log2( (1/2^E) sum_{P in 4^E} <psi|P|psi>^4 ) of the doubled-Fibonacci Levin-Wen ground space; runs labeled 'kondensat' (condensate ground state), 'random_gs' (random ground-space vector), and 'eigh_basis' (eigenbasis representative); dM2 is the Monte-Carlo standard error over 1.5e5 reduced-Pauli-string samples.
provenance.generator: tsre_v2_robust.py (exact-diagonalization ground-space construction on the full 2^E edge-qubit Hilbert space); the exact-diagonalization engine that constructs the ground space is not part of this record, consistent with the Data and Code Availability statement.
provenance.control: Z_2 toric-code ground state on the identical edge-qubit honeycomb torus gives M_2 = 0 exactly (falsifiable null control).
provenance.anchors: M_2 estimator calibrated against M2(|0>)=0, M2(|+>)=0, M2(T|+>)=log2(4/3), additivity, and GHZ/Bell = 0.
provenance.note: Deposited as a values-and-provenance record: the numbers reproduce the published certificate range; the generating exact-diagonalization/sampling code is a separate, heavier construction not deposited here.
